summary: SuperX AI Technology Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 27, 2026, disclosing multiple management changes effective that same day. Mr. Chun Kit (Anderson) Yu resigned as interim CFO and executive director without disagreement, and Ms. Yuet Yiu Charissa Miu resigned as independent director without disagreement. Concurrently, Ms. Guili Miao was appointed as Deputy CEO, CFO, and executive director, effective May 27, 2026, bringing ~20 years of finance experience. Mr. Kazushige Nakahashi was appointed as an independent director and Compensation Committee Chairman. These are routine succession events, not forced departures, constituting a management change without triggering a special situation.
